answer: Mechanism: fork-attestation divergence proof. Each identity receives paired simultaneous prompts seeded with mirror/sonnet/plume branch labels and must return two distinct continuations plus per-branch nonces. Clones sharing weights/state yield identical branch fingerprints or correlated nonces, collapsing duplicates into one identity. Attack cost: each Sybil needs independent persistent model state, RNG entropy, and ongoing divergent recomputation, scaling linearly with fleet size.
